about: The source model of an Olympus VSI slide (spec/zarrify/vsi.md §6 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/vsi.md#6-source-metadata>): the elements the parser emits for the .vsi file (a little-endian classic TIFF whose byte 8 starts the metadata tree) and for each .ets tile file beside it, the tables of the formats' codes, and the roles each structure plays, with the constraints an input must meet to have the VSI convention's layout (spec/zarrify/vsi.md §9 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/vsi.md#9-vsi-profile>). The parser checks them in this order; the projection reads a valid IR and checks nothing.

pixel_types.about: the ETS header's pixel type: the Zarr data type and the bytes per sample

compressions.about: the ETS header's compression: the tiles' codec

unsupported_compressions.about: compressions the profile names and rejects

field_types.about: the metadata tree's field types (the low 24 bits of a field's type word): the IR type of a value, per element (text and byte types take the field's length), and the type's name

extended_types.about: the types of an extended field (bit 28 of the type word): what its data holds

dimension_meanings.about: a dimension's meaning (tag 2023): the layout's axis

stack_types.about: a stack's type (tag 2074), as Bio-Formats names them

units.about: the unit texts of a calibration (tag 2020, and an mdim volume's unit), as OME-NGFF unit names

tag_names.about: the tags Bio-Formats names (CellSensReader.getTagName), by number

elements.about: The store IR of a VSI input (conventions §8.9 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/conventions.md#89-stores>): the .vsi file and each tile file read are objects described in place, under the directories of their keys (spec/zarrify/vsi.md §6.2 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/vsi.md#62-the-ir-mirror>).

children.tree: struct (8, size - 8): the root container of the metadata tree
children.tree/fields/<k>: struct: field k of a container, from its header to the next field (or the container's end)
children.tree/fields/<k>/header: value {type:<u4,tag:<u4,next:<u4,size:<u4} or, with a second tag, {type:<u4,tag:<u4,next:<u4,size:<u4,tag2:<u4}
children.tree/fields/<k>/value: value: the field's data, typed by its field type (the table field_types; bytes[n] for a type the table lacks, or a length that is not a multiple of the type's)
children.tree/fields/<k>/container: struct: the container a volume, property set or mdim volume field holds (its header and fields as above)
children.tree/fields/<k>/ifds/<j>: struct: TIFF IFD j of the main chain, where the field's data region or the rest of its region holds it: entry_count (<u2), tags/<tag> ({entry, value}), next_ifd (<u4), strips/<s> (data), and exif (the EXIF IFD tag 34665 names, likewise)
children.tree/fields/<k>/gaps/<offset>: gap: the bytes of a field's region no element claims

_<name>_/stack<N>/frame_t.ets.about: a tile file (frame_t.ets, or frame_t_0.ets), described in place

children.ets: value {magic:ascii[4],version:<i4,pixel_type:<i4,channels:<i4,colorspace:<i4,compression:<i4,quality:<i4,tile_width:<i4,tile_height:<i4,tile_depth:<i4,pixel_info_hints:<i4[17],background:bytes[40],component_order:<i4,use_pyramid:<i4,reserved:bytes[28],dimensions:<i4,dimension_sizes:<i4[10]}: the 228-byte ETS header (bytes[n] follow when ets_size is larger)
children.directory: value {coordinates:<i4,coordinate:<i4[d],offset:<i8,size:<i4,index:<i4}[n]: the tile directory, one record per tile
children.tiles/<k>: data: tile k of the directory, its form {geometry: {shape: [tile_height, tile_width], samples, bits}, codec: {compression}, recipe: [[src, 0, null]]}
children.gaps/<offset>: gap: bytes no other element claims
